title: PersonProof
$comment: Generated by `pnpm build` in contracts/ from typespec/. Do not edit.

iss.description: The issuer: "console" for the console, or the name a team gives its own tool in the modules' setting.

sub.description: The person, as the module records the actor's `id`: an email in lower case, or the sign-in proxy's value.

name.description: The name to show, recorded as the actor's `displayName`.

role.description: The person's role from the access file at the time of the call.

aud.description: The module the call goes to: "foreman", "intake" or "gatekeeper".

iat.description: When it was signed, in seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

exp.description: When it ends, in seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z; at most 60 seconds after `iat`.

method.description: The request's method in upper case.

path.description: The request's path as sent in the request line, without the query.

bodyDigest.description: The SHA-256 of the request's body bytes as sent, in base64url without padding.

description:
The claims of a person proof (ADR 0151): the JSON Web Token that the console signs for one call of a module API in
the name of a person, sent in the header `OSF-Person`, signed with `alg` "Ed25519" and `typ` "osf-person+jwt". It is
bound to one module, one request and 30 seconds. Open: a module ignores a claim it does not know.
